title: Downloads, Permissions & SSL Security API
summary: Intercept downloads, handle camera/microphone permissions, and enforce SSL certificate policies and domain whitelists.

sections.title: File Download Management
sections.content: Control file downloads with beforeDownloadListener to customize target paths or cancel downloads, and downloadListener to track real-time progress.

sections.title: Camera, Microphone & Device Permissions
sections.content: Intercept WebRTC camera, microphone, and screen share requests via KromiumPermissionListener.

sections.title: SSL/TLS Certificate Policies
sections.content: Configure certificate validation error handling using SslErrorPolicy.

sections.title: Domain Sandboxing & Host Locking
sections.content: Lock the browser to navigate strictly within an allowed set of hostnames or domains.
